name: Coherent
tagline: Leading provider of photonics and advanced electronics for AI datacenter and industrial applications
hero_kpi_rationale: Segment de croissance clé porté par la forte demande des clients hyperscale construisant des datacenters AI, utilisant les nouveaux produits transcepteurs ZR/ZR+ et les solutions de transport télécom traditionnel.

kpis.signal: Ratio superieur a 4x au T2-2026 signale une demande IA datacenter exceptionnelle et une forte visibilite.
Passage de 7 clients livres a plus de 10 engagements clients OCS, montrant l'adoption du nouveau produit de commutation optique.
NVIDIA prend une participation de 2 Md USD au capital, assortie d'un accord d'approvisionnement CPO pluriannuel jusqu'a la fin de la decennie.
La direction estime le marche adressable incremental du CPO a plus de 15 Md USD, l'une des plus grandes opportunites de croissance long terme.
L'estimation du marche OCS relevee a plus de 4 Md USD, doublement de la vue precedente porte par l'elargissement des cas d'usage IA.
CapEx trimestriel de 290 M USD, contre 112 M un an plus tot, dedie a l'expansion accelere de la capacite indium phosphure.
Ratio de levier ramene a 0,5x contre 2,1x un an plus tot, desendettement accelere apres l'apport en capital de NVIDIA.
Le materiau proprietaire Thermadite transfere la chaleur 2 a 5 fois mieux que le cuivre pour le refroidissement des puces IA, revenus attendus fin 2027.

kpis.name_fr: Avantage cout plaquette 6 pouces indium phosphure
kpis.signal: Une plaquette 6 pouces produit plus de 4 fois plus de puces a moins de la moitie du cout d'une plaquette 3 pouces, avec des rendements superieurs.
Cession de l'activite aerospatiale et defense pour environ 400 M USD le 2 septembre 2025, avec une plus-value de 115 M USD, recentrant le groupe sur le datacenter et l'IA.

kpis.name_fr: Plus-value sur cession aerospatiale et defense
kpis.signal: Plus-value exceptionnelle de 115 M USD comptabilisee au T1-2026 sur la cession de l'activite aerospatiale et defense.

kpis.name_fr: Depreciation sur entites destinees a la vente
kpis.signal: Depreciation exceptionnelle de 85 M USD sur des entites du segment Industrial classees en vue de leur cession au T4-2025.
Denso et Mitsubishi Electric ont injecte 1 milliard USD pour 25 pourcent de Silicon Carbide LLC, fonds dedies a l'expansion des capacites SiC.
Chiffre d'affaires annuel record de 5 810 M USD sur l'exercice 2025, en hausse de 23 pourcent, tire par la demande datacenter et IA.

stories_kpis.description: Le chiffre d'affaires du T3 FY26 a augmenté de 21 % en glissement annuel.
La direction se concentre sur l’augmentation des investissements en capital pour soutenir la capacité.
Le bénéfice GAAP par action du T3 FY26 a progressé de 1,08 $ YoY.
Le chiffre d'affaires du T2 FY26 a augmenté de 17 % en glissement annuel.
Le bénéfice GAAP par action du T2 FY26 a progressé de 71 % YoY.

ai_positioning.summary: Coherent is a significant beneficiary of AI datacenter buildouts. The company experienced stronger demand throughout fiscal 2025 in its Communications market driven by hyperscale and cloud customers building AI datacenters. Strong demand for datacenter transceivers and new ZR/ZR+ transceiver products directly supports the AI infrastructure buildout.
evidence: Increased number of hyperscale and cloud customers building AI datacenters drove demand for datacenter transceivers
Strong demand for new ZR/ZR+ transceiver products from AI datacenter customers
Growing demand for telecom transport products supporting AI datacenter infrastructure
Focus on display and semiconductor capital equipment within Industrial segment supporting AI chip manufacturing

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cyberattacks and security incidents that could result in costly damages, claims, expenses, reputational harm, competitive disadvantage, or operational disruption. Board oversight through NCG Committee with quarterly briefings on cybersecurity risks and incidents. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Cybersecurity attacks and incidents and other vulnerabilities could subject us to costly damages, claims and". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Company is vulnerable to cybersecurity threats with potential for significant financial and reputational impact. Mitigated by dedicated Chief Information Officer and Global Head of Cybersecurity with combined 45+ years experience including 20+ years in cybersecurity.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in competitive markets where pricing and margin pressures could result from competing products and services. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "We may encounter increased competition, and we may fail to accurately estimate our competitors or". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Competitive market dynamics may impact pricing power and gross margins across Communications and Industrial segments.

risks.title: Geopolitical and Trade Risks
risks.score_rationale: US-China tariffs, trade sanctions, and rare earth mineral export restrictions could disrupt supply chain and increase costs. In 2025, significant new tariffs were implemented and retaliatory measures taken by multiple countries. China restricted exports of rare earth minerals used in company products. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Significant political, trade, regulatory developments, and other circumstances beyond our control, including as a result". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Geopolitical tensions including US-China tariffs, trade sanctions, and rare earth mineral export restrictions present material risks. Diversified global manufacturing footprint and internal production capabilities provide some mitigation. However, sustained disruption in global trade could result in revenue reduction, cost increases, or production delays.

risks.title: Restructuring Plans
risks.score_rationale: Company approved multiple restructuring plans (2023 Plan, 2025 Plan, Synergy Plan) resulting in significant charges and operational disruption. Fiscal 2025 charges totaled 177 million dollars combined. Actual timing and costs may differ materially from estimates. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Tax-related matters could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations, or". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Ongoing restructuring activities including site consolidations, workforce reductions, and facility relocations may create operational challenges and cost volatility. Expected completion by end of fiscal 2026, but actual outcomes may differ materially.

risks.title: Asset Impairments
risks.score_rationale: Company recorded non-cash impairment charges of 85 million dollars in Q4 fiscal 2025 related to assets held-for-sale. Goodwill impairment risk exists if fair value determinations do not support carrying amounts due to cyclical business conditions. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Products that fail to meet specifications, are defective, or are otherwise incompatible with end uses". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Asset impairments including 85 million dollar charge on held-for-sale entities in Q4 2025. Goodwill impairment risk present given cyclical nature of business and potential for downturns in customer demand affecting reporting unit fair values.

risks.title: Macroeconomic and Cyclical Risks
risks.score_rationale: Company operates in cyclical markets with exposure to fluctuations in customer demand, capital spending cycles, and general economic conditions. Downturns in customer demand, operational challenges, and adverse macroeconomic conditions could materially impact profitability. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Coherent optical communications products and technologies enable next-generation high-speed optical transmission systems and transport networks". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: Business is subject to cyclical demand patterns and macroeconomic headwinds. While Communications segment benefited from AI datacenter buildouts in fiscal 2025, Industrial segment faced weak overall end-market demand. Future downturns could materially impact financial results.

company_description: Coherent Corp. develops, manufactures, and markets engineered materials, optoelectronic components and devices, and laser systems for the use in the industrial, communications, electronics, and instrumentation markets worldwide. It operates through three segments: Networking, Materials, and Lasers. The Networking segment offers transceivers, systems, subsystems, modules, components, optics, and semiconductor devices for datacenter and communications applications. The Materials segment provides engineered materials, laser optics, thermoelectric components, and advanced ceramic and metal-matrix composite materials and products; and vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser, edge-emitting laser, pump lasers, high-power lasers for materials processing, and integrated circuit. The Laser segment offers excimer lasers, solid-state lasers, CO2 lasers, and laser systems for various industrial applications, including semiconductor capital equipment, display manufacturing, precision manufacturing, and scientific research; and laser systems and subsystems. It markets its products and services through direct sales force, representatives, and distributors. The company was formerly known as II-VI In
